Episode Notes:
As AI systems become increasingly sophisticated, the possibility of more sophisticated threats by nefarious actors also rises. In her recent article for War on the Rocks, Rebecca Hersman argues the United States should create an AI Threat Fusion Center, and she joins Nicole for this episode of The Insider to unpack that proposal and help listeners understand why the upfront cost is worth it in the long run.
